profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下13:3では、ヨナダブをダビデの兄弟シメアの子と呼びます。
profile.identityNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の表記はShimeah。英語版記事が挙げるShammahとの関連は補助資料に基づく表記関係。

facts.textJa: サムエル記下13:32も、ヨナダブをシメアの子、シメアをダビデの兄弟と記します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.

Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
